notes.content:

3. Skill adjustment: Solved the problem of laser skills and random shaking.
4. Skill adjustment: replaced multiple arrow skills and arrow models.
5. The character panel UI background has been replaced with blue, replacing the character Icon.

notes.title: Updated content on March 19, 2022
notes.content:
1. Added function: Added task target points on the mini map
2. Correction: Reduced the beginner guidance level process and advanced the small tasks for controlling the new soldiers of the Intelligent Iron Tribe .
3. Add function: The mini map can be clicked, and then the camera switches to the clicked position
4. Correction: Bug with incorrect card position when dragging cards in challenge mode at high resolution
5. Add function: in the third person, press F1, F2, F3 to control the movement of teammates
6. Add function: let AI follow you in third person
7. Add function: Once the plot level has been completed, open a new archive, and you can directly complete the process of receiving rewards
8. Additional features: Eating a big meal in a tavern to replenish health
9. Revised content: Direction of impactor skills

notes.title: 2023.5.12 Update Description
notes.content:
1. The first optional hero, Ollie's main class becomes a Double Axe Berserker.
2. The skill correction value of ordinary attack of two handed axe, two-handed sword and two handed spear is increased.
3. Skill "Double handed Axe Strike", skill correction value increased.
4. Once the big map enters a paused state, it will be changed to: only when the character starts moving or manually starts running will it enter the running state, rather than automatically running immediately.
5. Added mini maps for battlefield and plot modes, displaying map boundaries and character positions.
